PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY____________________________________________________________
Software Engineer specializing in JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience developing and maintaining
production web applications across frontend and backend systems. Experienced with React, API integrations, UI
workflows, backend data modeling, and production delivery within healthcare technology. Brings a quality-first
engineering perspective developed through extensive experience in automation, reliability, and production
troubleshooting. Experienced in AI-assisted development using Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate delivery
while maintaining high-quality, maintainable code.
● Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, HTML/CSS
● Web & Backend: React, Node.js, REST APIs, Angular
● Testing & Quality: Cypress, Jest, Vitest, Postman, Gherkin, LambdaTest, WCAG/Accessibility Testing
● AI-Assisted Development: Cursor, Claude Code
● Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3), Docker, Azure DevOps, GitLab, GitHub, Git
● Observability & Analytics: BigQuery, Datadog, Microsoft App Insights, LogDNA
● Tools & Services: Swagger, Visual Studio, HL7 FHIR, Auth0, Contentful, Jira, Confluence
EXPERIENCE_________________________________________________________________________
Nov. 2024 - June 2026 	Software Engineer - Solera Health 	Phoenix, AZ (Remote)
● Developed and maintained production web application functionality using JavaScript and TypeScript,
including React components, API integrations, UI workflows, and bug fixes across legacy and modernized
application areas.
● Designed and engineered a standalone utility and third-party API integrations using TypeScript and
JavaScript, leveraging Cursor and Claude Code to expand core platform capabilities and unblock the
successful onboarding of a major enterprise client.
● Led the architectural migration of a legacy data configuration model to a modernized, decoupled internal
structure, coordinating a phased rollout strategy that ensured zero user downtime.
● Architected backend relational data models to support nested hierarchical organization structures,
enabling complex client configurations while establishing reusable modules that reduced engineering
effort for future client onboards.
● Owned the end-to-end delivery of a major program transition from development through production
launch, managing deployment pipelines via Azure DevOps to ensure a seamless release with zero
post-launch rollbacks or hotfixes.
● Refactored and stabilized the core automated testing framework using Cypress, eliminating flaky test
instances to accelerate CI/CD pipeline cycles by preventing unnecessarily failing and stuck builds.
